articles.author: Dan De Luce, Gordon Lubold, Courtney Kube, Abigail Williams
articles.title: Trump administration weighs drastic cut to U.S. forces in Europe of 25,000 or more - NBC News
articles.description: Current proposals from the Pentagon call for 25,000 to 50,000 troops to be removed from Europe as part of Pentagon policy chief Bridge Colby’s plan to realign American forces in Europe.
